999008199.text: 暴走はおさまったかな。シトリン。そっちはどうだい

localizations.en: Looks like the rampage has settled down. How are things on your end, Citrine?

999008199.text:
うん、大丈夫だと思う。今まで呼び出された人達の
力が予想より遙かに強大で負荷がかかってしまった…

localizations.en: Yeah, I think we're good. The people who got summoned this time were way more powerful than expected, so it put a huge strain on the system...

999008199.text: こんな感じかな？　門が暴走した理由は

localizations.en: Something like that? That's why the gate went haywire.

999008199.text:
一瞬の暴走とはいえ、影響が出ない事を祈るばかりだ。
なにせ、この地にある門は

localizations.en: Even if it was just a brief rampage, I can only hope there won't be any lasting effects. After all, the gate in this place is...

999008199.text:
異邦人たちの世界とうちの世界を繋ぐ機構――
世界の門だからね

localizations.en: The mechanism that connects the wanderers' worlds to ours—the World Gate.

999008199.text: う～ん……暇じゃーい！！！

おいたわしや姉様。
このような蕩けたお姿になられて……

localizations.en: How pitiful, Alvina. To see you in such a listless state...

999008199.text:
不肖ベップ、全力で姉様を楽しませる所存。
何がいいかしら？　踊り？　遊び？　選びたい放題

localizations.en: I, Bepp, shall do everything in my power to entertain you. What would you like? Dancing? Games? The choice is yours.

999008199.text:
今のアタシは生半可なものでは満足しないよ！
さーてベップ、何をしてもらおうか……！

localizations.en: I'm not satisfied with half-hearted stuff right now! So Bepp, what are you gonna do for me...?

999008199.text:
こーら。サボらない。ケイウン周辺の海域を
調査するべきだって言ったのはアルビーナでしょ？

localizations.en: Hey now. No slacking off. You're the one who said we should investigate the waters around Keiun, remember?

999008199.text:
そうだけどー……見渡しても海ばっかりで、
変化が無くてさあ。なんだか心配になるというか

localizations.en: I know, but... everywhere I look, it's just ocean with no changes. It's kind of worrying, you know?

999008199.text:
ふふ、私も最初はそうだったなあ。
本当に進んでるのか、陸が見えないと不安で不安で

localizations.en: Hehe, I felt the same way at first. When you can't see land, you get anxious wondering if you're actually making progress.

999008199.text:
そういう時は寝るに限るわ。
どこでも寝られるようにする。素晴らしい能力よ

localizations.en: When that happens, sleeping is the way to go. Being able to sleep anywhere is a wonderful ability.

999008199.text:
そっちは余裕っすなー。
これが経験の差ってやつですかい

localizations.en: You sure seem relaxed. I guess this is what they call the difference experience makes.

999008199.text:
ワーワーうるさいわね。
そんなに騒いでたら何かあった時に体力が持たないわよ

localizations.en: You're all being way too noisy. If you keep making such a racket, you won't have any energy left when something actually happens.

999008199.text:
そういうヨハナは静かかなあ？　まあ、言ってることは
正しいってハンマーが言ってるよ、アルビーナ

localizations.en: Are you really one to talk about being quiet, Johanna? Well, what you're saying is right though—my hammer agrees, Alvina.

999008199.text:
へーい。まったく、平和なことよのお。
ま、そんな時間が続いた方がしあわ――

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. Man, how peaceful things are. Well, I'd be happy if times like this could contin—

999008199.text:
なんか、今変な感じがしたわ。さっきご飯食べたのに、
もうお腹が空いている……そんな感じ

localizations.en: Something felt weird just now. Even though I just ate, I'm already hungry again... that kind of feeling.

999008199.text:
アタシも感じたよ。
何が変、とは言えないんだけど……

localizations.en: I felt it too. I can't really say what was strange about it, but...

999008199.text: ……姉様。おかしい。遠くに島が見える

localizations.en: ...Alvina. This is strange. I can see an island in the distance.

999008199.text:
島が見える……って、なんかおかしい？
別に普通じゃない？　島の一つくらいあるっしょ

localizations.en: An island... what's weird about that? That's totally normal, right? There's bound to be an island or two around.

999008199.text:
それが、地図にない島なのよ。
それにあんな島……さっきまであった？

localizations.en: The thing is, it's not on the map. And that island... was it there before?

999008199.text:
よくわからないけど、奇々怪々、何かが起きてる……
ってことだよね

localizations.en: I'm not sure, but something mysterious is definitely happening...

999008199.text:
場所によるものなら、引き返してみるのも
手だと思うけど……

localizations.en: If it's location-based, turning back might be an option...

999008199.text: 行ってみよ。あの島

localizations.en: Let's go check out that island.

999008199.text:
せっかく面白いことになってきたところ！
引き返すなんて、とんでもないっしょ！

localizations.en: Things are finally getting interesting! Turning back now would be crazy!
